name: alg_perm_eq_mul_two_involutions
statement: (n : ℕ) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) : ∃ a b : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), a * a = 1 ∧ b * b = 1 ∧ σ = a * b
closed: ∀ (n : ℕ) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)), ∃ a b : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), a * a = 1 ∧ b * b = 1 ∧ σ = a * b
informal: Every permutation of a finite set is a product of two involutions — on each cycle (x, σx, …, σ^{m-1}x) define a as the reflection σ^i x ↦ σ^{-i} x; then a is an involution and a σ a = σ⁻¹, so b = a σ satisfies b² = 1 and σ = a b.
type: ∀ (n : ℕ) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)), ∃ a b, a * a = 1 ∧ b * b = 1 ∧ σ = a * b

theorem alg_perm_eq_mul_two_involutions (n : ℕ) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) : ∃ a b : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), a * a = 1 ∧ b * b = 1 ∧ σ = a * b := by
  have H : (∀ τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), τ.IsCycle →
        ∃ a : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), a * a = 1 ∧ a * τ * a = τ⁻¹ ∧ ∀ x : Fin n, τ x = x → a x = x) ∧
      (∀ τ ρ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), τ.Disjoint ρ →
        (∃ a : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), a * a = 1 ∧ a * τ * a = τ⁻¹ ∧ ∀ x : Fin n, τ x = x → a x = x) →
        (∃ a : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), a * a = 1 ∧ a * ρ * a = ρ⁻¹ ∧ ∀ x : Fin n, ρ x = x → a x = x) →
        (∃ a : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), a * a = 1 ∧ a * (τ * ρ) * a = (τ * ρ)⁻¹ ∧ ∀ x : Fin n, (τ * ρ) x = x → a x = x)) := by
    clear σ
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩ <;> sorry
  obtain ⟨hc, hd⟩ := H
  have key : ∃ a : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), a * a = 1 ∧ a * σ * a = σ⁻¹ ∧ ∀ x : Fin n, σ x = x → a x = x := by
    induction σ using Equiv.Perm.cycle_induction_on with
    | base_one => exact ⟨1, by simp, by simp, fun x _ => rfl⟩
    | base_cycles τ hτ => exact hc τ hτ
    | induction_disjoint τ ρ hdis _ h1 h2 => exact hd τ ρ hdis h1 h2
  obtain ⟨a, haa, hconj, -⟩ := key
  refine ⟨a, a * σ, haa, ?_, ?_⟩
  · calc a * σ * (a * σ) = (a * σ * a) * σ := by group
      _ = 1 := by rw [hconj]; simp
  · calc σ = (a * a) * σ := by rw [haa, one_mul]
      _ = a * (a * σ) := by group

∀ (n : ℕ) (τ ρ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)), τ.Disjoint ρ → (∃ (a : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)), a * a = 1 ∧ a * τ * a = τ⁻¹ ∧ ∀ (x : Fin n), (τ : Fin n → Fin n) x = x → (a : Fin n → Fin n) x = x) → (∃ (a : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)), a * a = 1 ∧ a * ρ * a = ρ⁻¹ ∧ ∀ (x : Fin n), (ρ : Fin n → Fin n) x = x → (a : Fin n → Fin n) x = x) → ∃ (a : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)), a * a = 1 ∧ a * (τ * ρ) * a = (τ * ρ)⁻¹ ∧ ∀ (x : Fin n), (τ * ρ : Fin n → Fin n) x = x → (a : Fin n → Fin n) x = x
